title: Jared Goff: Sam LaPorta is a stud, we've got to find ways to get him the ball

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jared Goff: Sam LaPorta is a stud, we've got to find ways to get him the ball
sources.description: After a strong rookie season in 2023, Lions tight end Sam LaPorta's production has declined each year, and last year his season was cut short by a back injury that required surgery.
